text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking with Daitaku Helios and 
talking about our plans for the future...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, if it isn't Flowercchi! What are ya 
up to?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Helios-san! Parent's day observation 
just ended, so I'm showing my parents 
around the academy right now.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hello. Thank you for always taking care of 
my daughter.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, nice to meetcha☆ The academy's 
super fun, so check it out♪

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's so vast and wonderful to see. I 
wonder what you'll show me next, 
Flower-chan?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, over there next! It's the flower bed 
I take care of for the Beautification 
Committee—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—Huh!? The fence is broken...! The way it 
snapped... it was rotten...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the wind was super strong last night. 
But the flowers look totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But it's dangerous if we leave it 
like this. We have to fix it right away!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
20 support beams and 30 wooden boards. 
Twine for tying and a hammer... yeah. I 
should be good if I take all this.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Huh, do you really need that many? 
...Can't you just fix the broken part?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, the wood around the broken part was 
rotten too. It's dangerous unless we 
replace all of it!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
However, carrying this much... What if 
Flower-chan pushes herself too hard and 
gets hurt...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty! Imma call the usual crew for 
now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Helios! I'm here to help out♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Flower-cchi! What's up, you need this 
carried over~?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah, um...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
With this many people, it's a piece of 
cake! We'll be done in seconds!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! ...U-Um, could you carry everything 
over to where the big hollow tree is?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayyy! Keep 'em co-mingggâª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The students gathered by Daitaku Helios 
cheerfully carried the materials. They 
finished hauling everything in no time 
flat!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! Thanks to you, we 
were able to carry them quickly!

text_block_list.name: Helios and the Regulars
text_block_list.text: Yaaay☆ Totally not a problem!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Knowing you, Flower, I was worried 
you'd try to shoulder everything alone. 
But... you've got seniors you can count 
on!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right...! Everyone's so nice, 
they're great upperclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, we're besties!☆ Whenever you're 
feelin' down, just gimme a ring, 'kay?♪

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Everyone, I hope you will all 
continue to be good friends with my 
daughter.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Of couuurse!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well then, time to fix this up too♪ Demon 
speed!
choice_data_list:
Let's divide up the work and finish this 
quickly!
Let's use tools to work more efficiently

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Okey-doke! Let's do this, everyone~~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Waaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should help out too. Flower, what 
should we do?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then, I'll give everyone 
instructions...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: C'moooon! Let's blow 'em away~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By splitting up the work, the fence was 
fixed in no time. Having seen it through, 
Daitaku Helios looked so proud and happy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Roger! I'll go look for something!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Is this... an excavator?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yup☆ Borrowed it from the janitor! So, how 
do ya use it?
choice_data_list: It's dangerous, so I'll do it instead.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trai-pi! So reliable, 
whoooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the excavator, setting up the 
fence went quickly. I made sure to shower 
Daitaku Helios with praise for a job well 
done!
